name: Sabretooth

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.

signatureAbility:
Untamed Heart
When struck or when blocking a Critical Hit, Sabretooth gains a Regeneration Passive, healing [25- 70]% of the damage taken from the hit over 25 seconds. These Regenerations are removed and new ones cannot be granted is Sabretooth is Heal Blocked.
Fury and Regeneration effects receive a permanent +[70 - 120]% flat Ability Accuracy.
If Sabretooth does not hit or get struck by the opponent for more than 5 seconds, he starts losing Regeneration stacks over time.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Sabretooth can withstand incredibly cold temperatures, providing him Immunity to Cold Damage like Coldsnap and Frostbite.
Sabretooth does not let his prey go easily. Stun Debuffs on the Opponent cannot have their duration reduced.

abilitySections.title: Persistent Charge
content: At the start of the fight, if Sabretooth has 0 Persistent Charges, he will randomly receive between 3 and 6 Persistent Charges.

At the start of the fight, if Sabretooth has a Persistent Charge, he consumes one, re-activating up to 30 of his Fury effects that were active at the end of his last fight as permanent Passive Fury effects.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: Every 10 hits on Sabretooth's or 5 hits on the opponent's Combo Meters, Sabretooth gains a Fury. Against Skill Champions, Sabretooth also inflicts an Armor Break if he is attacking, reducing the opponents Armor Rating by [687.5] for 10 seconds.
Fury increases Attack Rating by [2,273.25] for 6 seconds.
Sabretooth lives for the thrill of the kill and starts each fight in Battlegrounds with 5 Passive versions of this Fury.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Dodging back and allowing Sabretooth to idle for 1.40 second allows him to convert a temporary Fury Buff into a permanent passive effect.
Sabretooth can convert a maximum of 5 permanent Fury passives in a fight. Fury effects from previous fights do not count towards this limitation.
Sabretooth cannot convert his passive Fury effects while fighting if he has 15 or more permanent passive Fury effects active.
Once Sabretooth has conveted the maximum number of Fury Passives during a fight, the Fury Buff from his Combo Gain gains 200% increased duration and 50% increased potency.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: 80% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [7,274.4] Direct Damage over 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation and on the final hit, converts personal Fury Buffs into a permanent Passive Fury effect.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Activates a Fury effect and immediately converts it to a Passive effect, increasing Attack Rating by [1,363.95] permanently.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gains a Fury Buff, increasing Attack Rating by [4,091.85] for 2 seconds.
